Container.Name: GameLib
Container.Overview: Self-hosted game library for the games share. Tracks game folders (one folder per version) in a Lutris-style cover grid with statuses, ratings, tags, groups and categories from your subfolders. Scans the share in the background, finds artwork in game folders (including .exe icons) or on SteamGridDB, flags missing folders and duplicates, shows storage use, uploads zips into the share and downloads any version as a zip. Export/import of the whole library. Single user, for your LAN.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Host port for the library UI. The container always listens on 8080; change only this value if 8080 is taken.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, cover images, temporary uploads and automatic DB backups. Keep it on the appdata share (cache) and include it in your appdata backups.

Config.Name: Games share
Config.Description: Your games share. One folder per version, e.g. 'Hollow Knight v1.5.78'. Read-write is needed for uploads and 'delete files'. Use mode 'ro' to make it track-only.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Login password (required). The container will not start without it.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. 99 = nobody (Unraid default).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. 100 = users (Unraid default).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions for files the app creates on the share. 002 = group-writable. Use 000 if SMB users can't modify uploaded games.

Config.Name: Trusted origins
Config.Description: Only for a reverse proxy on a different hostname: comma-separated host[:port] values allowed to send write requests, e.g. games.example.com

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Set to 1 only when the UI is served over HTTPS (reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Max unpacked size (GB)
Config.Description: Uploaded zips that would unpack to more than this are rejected (zip-bomb guard).

Config.Name: Scan depth
Config.Description: How many folder levels Scan looks into (1-6). 3 fits Group/Category/Game v1. Level 1 folders are groups, deeper ones categories.

Config.Name: Rescan time
Config.Description: Local time (HH:MM) of the scheduled background rescan of the share, when disks are usually idle.

Config.Name: Rescan every (hours)
Config.Description: How often the scheduled rescan runs, counted from the rescan time. 0 turns scheduled rescans off (Rescan now still works).

Config.Name: Light job threads
Config.Description: Threads for quick background jobs. Heavy share jobs always run one at a time.

Config.Name: SteamGridDB API key
Config.Description: Optional. Free key from steamgriddb.com (Preferences > API) for box art. Can also be set in the app under Settings > Integrations. Only used when you click a SteamGridDB button.
